title: phaca subcinerea
intro: Phaca subcinerea, commonly known as Subcinereous Lupin, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. This perennial herb is native to the mountainous regions of the Indian subcontinent and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Phaca subcinerea include its potential to treat various ailments such as diabetes, arthritis, and digestive issues due to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Phaca subcinerea include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of lowering blood sugar levels, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity.
